与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:欧文的经历、感受与成长。
Owen is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Little by little, things began to change. They enjoy quiet weekends in the countryside.

Owen bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, travel insurance covers lost bags.

Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Owen prefers rainy weather when running in the park. People around Owen often share different ideas about the train station. The return fare is nine pounds.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. The night market has become an important part of daily life. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the new mall has an ice rink.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Tuesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. The experience taught Owen more than any book could.
